[[File:CloneNavalOfficer-TCWCE.png|thumb|right|250px|A clone naval officer]]
'''Clone navigation officers''', also known as '''clone naval officers''' or '''clone navigators''', were [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] specifically trained in technical and tactical aspects of [[Space warfare/Legends|naval command]].

==History==
[[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] speculated that [[Cloning/Legends|clones']] aptitude for [[Space warfare/Legends|space combat]] came from [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] understanding of [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]] tactics, but even amongst [[Gender/Legends|his]] clones some had proved themselves capable of understanding and executing naval strategy to a greater degree than their brothers. Those clones received special naval training and many of them eventually became [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], although most of them were lower-tier [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] and [[Aide/Legends|aides]] to superior non-clone officers. Some of those officers believed that despite their training the clones were not suited for a role of an officer, which sometimes led to rising tensions aboard [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. Although [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] such as [[Rom Mohc]] had a high opinion of clones and relished working with them, others decided to avoid following Mohc's kindness. As a result, these naval officers had tense relationships with their superiors.
